points.K2: 公众和工作人员都有剂量限值
points.K4: 反应看剂量，效应分早晚
points.K8: 皮肤和性腺的局部损伤
points.K9: 影响敏感性的四个因素
points.K11: 人体多是水：水的辐射分解

shots.scene: 欣欣站在木框白板前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard in a wooden frame and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们打好辐射安全的基础。
overlay: 辐射安全基础：来源、剂量与生物效应

shots.scene: 太阳、刻度尺、细胞三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a sun, a blank measuring ruler and a simple cell. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射从哪来、怎么量、对人有啥影响。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在贴着电离辐射警告标志的实验室门口，耸肩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a lab door with an ionizing radiation warning sign and shrugs casually.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进放射实验室，满不在乎。

shots.scene: 阿杰对小研摆手，旁边画一个很小的剂量计图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves his hand dismissively to the female graduate student, next to a tiny dosimeter icon.
shots.narration: “剂量这么小，没关系吧？”

shots.scene: 小研摇头，手里拿着空白笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head, holding a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄懂辐射，再谈没关系。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们从头说起。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向天空中的星星、餐桌上的水和面包、脚下的岩石
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of stars in the sky, a glass of water and bread on a table, and rocks on the ground.
shots.narration: 辐射有天然的，来自宇宙、食物和大地。

shots.scene: 核电站冷却塔和医院影像检查床两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two simple icons: a nuclear power plant cooling tower and a hospital imaging table. No people.
shots.narration: 也有人工的，来自核工业和医学影像。

shots.section_title: 公众和工作人员都有剂量限值
shots.scene: 一群普通人的图标和一名穿工作服的辐射工作人员图标，各自头顶一条空白刻度尺
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crowd of ordinary people and one radiation worker in a lab coat, each with a blank scale bar above. Icons only, no people.
shots.narration: 公众和辐射工作人员，都有年剂量限值。
overlay: 公众和工作人员都有剂量限值

shots.section_title: 公众和工作人员都有剂量限值
shots.scene: 普通人图标旁一条短刻度尺，标出两个刻度
shots.prompt_en: An icon of ordinary people next to a short scale bar with two marks on it. No people.
shots.narration: 公众持续照射，每年1毫希沃特。

shots.section_title: 公众和工作人员都有剂量限值
shots.scene: 同一刻度尺上第二个刻度亮起
shots.prompt_en: The second mark on the same short scale bar lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 偶尔受照的，每年5毫希沃特。

shots.section_title: 公众和工作人员都有剂量限值
shots.scene: 欣欣指着工作人员图标上方一条更长的刻度尺
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a longer scale bar above a radiation worker icon.
shots.narration: 工作人员每年50毫希沃特，即5雷姆。

shots.scene: 一块方块吸收了很多小能量点
shots.prompt_en: A cube absorbing many small glowing energy dots. No people.
shots.narration: 拉德或戈瑞，表示吸收剂量。

shots.scene: 同样的能量点打在人体轮廓上，旁边一个生物效应的心形图标
shots.prompt_en: The same energy dots hit a simple human body outline, with a small heart-shaped health icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 雷姆或希沃特，表示剂量当量。

shots.section_title: 反应看剂量，效应分早晚
shots.scene: 一个旋钮从小拧到大，人体图标颜色从浅到深
shots.prompt_en: A dial turns from low to high while a body outline icon changes color from pale to deep. No people.
shots.narration: 人体的反应，和受到的剂量有关。
overlay: 反应看剂量，效应分早晚

shots.section_title: 反应看剂量，效应分早晚
shots.scene: 几种不同形状的细胞，有的发红有的平静
shots.prompt_en: Several cells of different shapes; some glow red, others stay calm. No people.
shots.narration: 不同的细胞，怕辐射的程度不一样。

shots.section_title: 反应看剂量，效应分早晚
shots.scene: 时间轴上，左端闪电图标，右端日历翻过多年
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with a lightning icon at the left end and a calendar flipping through many years at the right end. No people.
shots.narration: 效应有的很快出现，有的多年后才显现。

shots.scene: 细胞快速一分为二、二分为四的动画
shots.prompt_en: Animation of a cell rapidly dividing into two, then four, then eight. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞分裂越快，组织生长越旺，越敏感。

shots.scene: 检查床上的人体图标，下腹部盖着一块铅护垫
shots.prompt_en: A body icon on an imaging table with a small lead shield covering the lower abdomen. No people.
shots.narration: 所以只要可能，就给性腺加屏蔽。

shots.scene: 孕妇图标旁的影像检查图标打上黄色提示
shots.prompt_en: A pregnant woman icon next to an imaging machine icon with a yellow caution mark. No people.
shots.narration: 孕早期三个月，尽量不拍X光片。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，白板上四个图标：全身、皮肤、血滴、染色体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside a whiteboard with four icons: a whole body, a patch of skin, a blood drop and a chromosome.
shots.narration: 早期效应有四类，照后几分钟到几天出现。

shots.scene: 规范的影像检查室图标，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tidy imaging room with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 操作规范的普通X光摄影，见不到这些。

shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，几个图标慢慢出现：血滴、皮肤、沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while icons slowly appear: a blood drop, a patch of skin and an hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 晚期效应在数月甚至数年后出现。

shots.scene: 一个罐子里一滴一滴积满水
shots.prompt_en: A jar filling up drop by drop with water. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量会累积，一点点也会攒起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣认真地摇头，旁边小剂量图标打黄色警示
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head seriously beside a small dose icon with a yellow warning mark.
shots.narration: 所以别把小剂量当成没剂量。

shots.section_title: 皮肤和性腺的局部损伤
shots.scene: 皮肤图标从正常变成发红
shots.prompt_en: A skin patch icon changes from normal color to red. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤受照，先是发红。
overlay: 皮肤和性腺的局部损伤

shots.section_title: 皮肤和性腺的局部损伤
shots.scene: 发红的皮肤图标出现脱皮破损
shots.prompt_en: The reddened skin icon starts peeling and breaking. No people.
shots.narration: 再重一些，就会脱皮甚至溃破。

shots.section_title: 皮肤和性腺的局部损伤
shots.scene: 生殖干细胞图标外面画一个警示圈
shots.prompt_en: Icons of reproductive stem cells with a warning circle around them. No people.
shots.narration: 性腺也受影响，干细胞阶段最敏感。

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 欣欣指着白板上的四个图标：氧气泡、生日蛋糕、创可贴、试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at four icons on a whiteboard: an oxygen bubble, a birthday cake, a bandage and a blank reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 四个因素会改变细胞对辐射的敏感性。
overlay: 影响敏感性的四个因素

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 充满氧气泡的组织图标颜色变深
shots.prompt_en: A tissue icon full of oxygen bubbles turns a deeper color. No people.
shots.narration: 有氧的组织更敏感，叫氧效应。

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 影像检查床上的人体图标，周围飘着氧气泡
shots.prompt_en: A body icon on an imaging table surrounded by small oxygen bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 诊断X射线，都是在充分氧合下进行。

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 婴儿、青年、老人三个图标，婴儿旁警示最大
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of a baby, a young adult and an elderly person, with the biggest warning mark beside the baby. No people.
shots.narration: 越年轻越敏感。

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 受损的细胞图标慢慢自我修补
shots.prompt_en: A damaged cell icon slowly repairs itself. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量不足以杀死细胞时，它能自我修复。

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 试剂瓶图标旁边的细胞颜色变化
shots.prompt_en: A blank reagent bottle icon next to a cell whose color changes. No people.
shots.narration: 某些化学物质，也能改变辐射反应。

shots.section_title: 影响敏感性的四个因素
shots.scene: 辐射防护剂药瓶图标旁画一个骷髅毒性符号，人体图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank medicine bottle icon with a skull toxicity symbol, next to a human body icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射防护剂毒性大，不用于人。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白坐标图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a large blank graph with two axes.
shots.narration: 剂量和效应的关系，常用三种模型。

shots.scene: 坐标图上一条从某点开始上升的直线
shots.prompt_en: A graph with a straight line that starts rising only after a point above zero. No people.
shots.narration: 有阈模型：剂量过了门槛才出现效应。

shots.scene: 坐标图上一条从原点出发的直线
shots.prompt_en: A graph with a straight line rising from the origin. No people.
shots.narration: 无阈模型：任何剂量都可能有效应。

shots.scene: 坐标图上一条弯曲的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A graph with a smooth curved line. No people.
shots.narration: 直线是线性，弯的曲线是非线性。

shots.section_title: 人体多是水：水的辐射分解
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里八成是蓝色的水
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline mostly filled with blue water. No people.
shots.narration: 人体大约八成是水。
overlay: 人体多是水：水的辐射分解

shots.section_title: 人体多是水：水的辐射分解
shots.scene: 水分子被射线打散成几个小碎片
shots.prompt_en: A water molecule icon is hit by a ray and splits into several small fragments. No people.
shots.narration: 水受照会分解，这是体内最主要的作用。

shots.scene: 射线直接打中DNA双螺旋
shots.prompt_en: A ray directly hits a DNA double helix. No people.
shots.narration: 射线直接击中DNA，叫直接作用。

shots.scene: 射线打碎水分子，碎片再飞向DNA
shots.prompt_en: A ray splits a water molecule and the fragments then fly toward a DNA double helix. No people.
shots.narration: 先打碎水，碎片再伤DNA，叫间接作用。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着间接的大拇指图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside an arrow icon pointing from water to DNA.
shots.narration: 人体受照，以间接作用为主。

shots.scene: 小研和老周站在白板前，白板上一个孕妇图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man stand in front of a whiteboard showing a pregnant woman icon.
shots.narration: 辐射和妊娠，要特别小心。

shots.scene: 生育力图标旁打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A fertility icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 长期低剂量照射，一般不影响生育力。

shots.scene: 孕期日历，最前面几周标红
shots.prompt_en: A pregnancy calendar with the first few weeks highlighted in red. No people.
shots.narration: 孕早期最敏感，尤其是头两周。

shots.scene: 胎儿器官发育图标旁一个黄色警示
shots.prompt_en: A fetal organ development icon with a yellow warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第2到10周器官形成，可致骨骼器官畸形。

shots.scene: 一根很短的风险柱
shots.prompt_en: A very short risk bar on a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 宫内受照白血病相对危险约1.5，风险小。

shots.scene: 一个家族树图标，枝头上有一个小问号
shots.prompt_en: A family tree icon with a small question mark on one branch. No people.
shots.narration: 遗传效应按无阈处理，任何剂量都有风险。

shots.scene: 很小的概率骰子图标
shots.prompt_en: A tiny dice icon showing low probability. No people.
shots.narration: 不过辐射诱发的遗传效应很少见。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标，沙子慢慢落下
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon with sand slowly falling. No people.
shots.narration: 晚期效应有潜伏期，要很多年才出现。

shots.scene: 眼睛、血滴、甲状腺三个图标，各配一个长短不同的时间条
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an eye, a blood drop and a thyroid gland, each with a timeline bar of different length. No people.
shots.narration: 白内障的潜伏期，约5到30年。

shots.scene: 血滴图标配一条时间条，20年处仍有淡色延续
shots.prompt_en: A blood drop icon with a timeline bar that fades but continues far to the right. No people.
shots.narration: 白血病约4到7年，20年后仍有风险。

shots.scene: 甲状腺图标配一条长时间条
shots.prompt_en: A thyroid gland icon with a long timeline bar. No people.
shots.narration: 甲状腺癌的潜伏期约20年。

shots.scene: 一大群人图标里只有极少数变色
shots.prompt_en: A large crowd of people icons where only a very few change color. No people.
shots.narration: 每拉德约万分之八恶性肿瘤风险，总体低。

shots.scene: 阿杰在台灯下翻空白教材做笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank textbook and takes notes under a desk lamp.
shots.narration: 这些概念，课后要回到教材里复习。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上书，握拳给自己打气
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the blank textbook and pumps his fist with confidence.
shots.narration: 读完教材，祝考试顺利！

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现太阳、核电站和影像检查床图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a sun, a power plant and an imaging table.
shots.narration: 辐射有天然的，也有人工的。

shots.scene: 方块吸收能量和人体轮廓两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cube absorbing energy and a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 戈瑞量能量，希沃特量对人的影响。

shots.scene: 分裂的细胞、胎儿和沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dividing cell, a fetus and an hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 分裂快的细胞最敏感，效应有早有晚。

shots.scene: 积满水的罐子和向下的剂量箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a jar full of water drops and a downward dose arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量会累积，小剂量也当作有害。

shots.scene: 两条刻度尺：短的公众、长的工作人员
shots.prompt_en: Two scale bars: a short one for the public and a longer one for workers. No people.
shots.narration: 公众和工作人员，各有年剂量限值。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上笔记本，向小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes his blank notebook and nods to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：小剂量也要认真对待。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 打好基础，下次见！
